name: confirmation-candidate-reservation-audit-20260923
purpose: Metadata-only, reproducible eligibility and exclusion audit for all 50 admitted origins. No algorithm settings or performance-driven choices.

selection_policy.algorithm: Four passes of binary/multiclass/regression, taking the next lexicographic eligible family from each nonempty stratum; then repeat the same order over remaining eligible IDs until 12 or exhaustion. No randomness or performance ranking.

metadata_filters.exposure: Exclude the union of registry-exposed/history families, canonicalized historical cache identities and every live ledger admission, regardless of outcome/status.

toy_image_panel_exclusions.iris-anderson: Canonical scikit-learn toy/example panel; not a primary tabular claim.
toy_image_panel_exclusions.wine-cultivars: Canonical scikit-learn toy/example panel; not a primary tabular claim.
toy_image_panel_exclusions.wisconsin-diagnostic: Conservative exclusion of a standard scikit-learn toy/example image-summary panel.
toy_image_panel_exclusions.optical-digits: Homogeneous 8x8 pixel-count features; vision/toy stress, not primary heterogeneous tabular evidence.
toy_image_panel_exclusions.banknote-authentication: Conservative image-only panel exclusion: four wavelet image summaries, retained for development/stress rather than the primary tabular claim.

metadata_filters.taxonomy_scope: Use standard dataset headings/feature descriptions, not published scores. Banknote is a separately declared conservative image-summary exclusion.
metadata_filters.simulation_policy: Retain eligible domain-simulation candidates only with a separate secondary claim track; never count them as observational primary evidence.
metadata_filters.rights_scope: Existing private/local-use and no-redistribution/no-hosted-row-sharing restrictions remain binding; reservation grants no new permission.

exposure_proof.scope: Recorded project execution, not public pretraining or unlogged external activity.
exposure_proof.history_resolution: Map family IDs, aliases and source IDs through the existing registry. Explicit synthetic cache records use synthetic-prefixed identities, never a similarly named real family.

ledger.query: SELECT family_id,run_id,role,created_at FROM exposure ORDER BY family_id,run_id
ledger.logical_hash_encoding: SHA-256 of UTF-8 compact JSON for the sorted query rows.

exposure_proof.blinding: No project reports, results, predictions, model-cell metrics or extended-variant outcomes were opened. Historical cache readers used only dataset/source identity fields. No raw payloads or new dataset profiles were read.
exposure_proof.limitations: The pool was already publicly acquired/schema-validated; reservation means no recorded project model exposure, not unseen raw data or a guarantee about foundation-model pretraining.

datasets.name: tabarena-46922
datasets.prediction_time: Recorded early-readmission annotation from a completed index hospital stay. Original readmitted target and both identifiers are absent after curation; curator deduplicated patient_nbr. No clinical deployment claim.
datasets.evaluation_notes:
by the TabArena team (for code see the [page of the study](https://tabarena.ai/data-tabular-ml-iid-study)):
- We drop duplicated patients based on the "patient_nbr" feature to avoid target leakage.
- We reversed the original ordinal encoding for three ID-based features. 
- We created the target from the "readmitted" column following the original task description.
- We dropped "encounter_id" and "patient_nbr", which are both unique identifiers for each row.
- We keep original "?", NULL-codes, and NaN values because they exist in different ways across the columns.
- Anomaly: There is a distribution shift based on the original order. The reason for this might be that the encounters are ordered in some way such that later parts of the data contain different sub-groups than earlier parts. This is also indicate by the fact that the "payer_code" feature is responsible for the shift. This distribution shift vanishes after randomly shuffling the data (as done by default for this and all other datasets used in TabArena).
